dialogues.jp:
ベッドに横になって、ぼーっと窓の外を見つめ
る。
dialogues.en:
Even though I didn't have dinner, I'm not hungry at all. And
Nemu didn't try to talk to me either, maybe because she felt
something odd in my attitude.
dialogues.text:
Even though I didn't have dinner, I'm not hungry at all. And
Nemu didn't try to talk to me either, maybe because she felt
something odd in my attitude.

dialogues.jp: 今日は朝から大変だった。

身体は確かに疲れているのだが、頭は冴え冴え
でちっとも眠くならない。
dialogues.en:
I roll over onto my other side. Like a broken video tape,
the same scene is being repeated over and over again in my
head.
dialogues.text:
I roll over onto my other side. Like a broken video tape,
the same scene is being repeated over and over again in my
head.

dialogues.jp: （明日は眞子とデートだってのにな……）
dialogues.en:
Mako's face. Her hair. Her underwear. Her skin. Her sweat.
Her voice.
dialogues.text:
Mako's face. Her hair. Her underwear. Her skin. Her sweat.
Her voice.

dialogues.jp: 音夢には、無論デートの件は言ってない。
dialogues.en:
But I can actually feel her body, which wouldn't be possible
if I were just watching a video.
dialogues.text:
But I can actually feel her body, which wouldn't be possible
if I were just watching a video.

dialogues.jp:
朝の｛とんそう／遁走｝についてこってり絞られたのに、さら
にデートなどと言ったら、どうなるかわかった
もんじゃない。
dialogues.en: (I really did it with Mako......)
dialogues.text: (I really did it with Mako......)

dialogues.jp:
ましてや眞子と本当にキスをしたなどと知れた
日には……考えるだけで、背筋に冷たいものが
走る。
dialogues.en:
After it happened, we parted without really talking to each
other.
dialogues.text:
After it happened, we parted without really talking to each
other.

dialogues.jp:
（んー、でも本当に眞子とキスしたんだよな
　……）
dialogues.en:
I was shy, but more than that, I felt like running away from
the situation.
dialogues.text:
I was shy, but more than that, I felt like running away from
the situation.

dialogues.jp:
眞子の唇の柔らかさを思い出して、自分の唇に
指をあてる。
余韻というか、キスの実感がまだ残っていた。
dialogues.en: Do I really like Mako?
dialogues.text: Do I really like Mako?

dialogues.jp:
いかん、これから眠ろうって時に胸をドキドキ
させてどうするんだよ。
dialogues.en: My feelings are all mixed up.
dialogues.text: My feelings are all mixed up.

dialogues.jp: 静まれ、静まれ。この紋所が目に入らぬか？
dialogues.en: I don't know.
dialogues.text: I don't know.

dialogues.en: I don't know.
dialogues.text: I don't know.

dialogues.en: It's true that I feel something for Mako.
dialogues.text: It's true that I feel something for Mako.

dialogues.jp: ……よし、収まった。
dialogues.en:
But was it all right for me to do that just because I had
some feelings for her?
dialogues.text:
But was it all right for me to do that just because I had
some feelings for her?

dialogues.jp: （しかし……）

なんで突然、眞子が本当にキスをしてきたかは
分からない。

思えば今朝から、いつもと様子が違っていたよ
うな……。
dialogues.en: Honestly, I wonder how much I like Mako.
dialogues.text: Honestly, I wonder how much I like Mako.

dialogues.jp: 昨日の手紙が影響しているのか？
dialogues.en:
My mind is really distraught. Because the core of my being
is offline, I can't see anything.
dialogues.text:
My mind is really distraught. Because the core of my being
is offline, I can't see anything.

dialogues.jp: それとも成り行きで気持ちが高まったのか？
dialogues.en: My mind is cloudy.
dialogues.text: My mind is cloudy.

dialogues.jp: あるいは、ちょっとした気の迷い？
考えが四方八方に飛び散って、まとまらない。
dialogues.en: I close my eyes tight.
dialogues.text: I close my eyes tight.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、俺は俺であって、眞子本人でないの
だから正解が導き出せるはずもないのだが……。
dialogues.en: I breathe steadily.
dialogues.text: I breathe steadily.

dialogues.jp:
だけど、不思議と眞子とキスをしたという驚き
はあっても、キスをしてしまったという後悔の
念はまったく感じない。
dialogues.en:
If I keep calm like this, I guess my mind will be clear
someday, and I'll be able to find my real feelings.
dialogues.text:
If I keep calm like this, I guess my mind will be clear
someday, and I'll be able to find my real feelings.

dialogues.jp:
（もしかすると、あいつ……ファーストキス
　だったのかな……）
dialogues.en: ---- Feelings for Mako.
dialogues.text: ---- Feelings for Mako.

dialogues.jp: ◆自分の気持ち◆
dialogues.en: ◆The sound of the clock ticking.◆
dialogues.text: ◆The sound of the clock ticking.◆

dialogues.jp:
ベッドに寝転んで、昼間のことを思い出してい
た。
dialogues.en:
The rustling sound of the branches of cherry blossom outside
the window.
dialogues.text:
The rustling sound of the branches of cherry blossom outside
the window.

dialogues.jp:
なんで眞子はキスなんてしたのだろう……俺た
ちは付き合ってるフリをしているだけなのに。

明日は眞子とデートだ。早く眠らなくてはと、
取留めもない考え事を打ち切って俺は目を閉じ
たのだった。
dialogues.en: I stare up at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I stare up at the ceiling.
